title: Buying Indian Clothes Online from India: Shipping, Customs and Sizing Explained
excerpt: What to know before ordering Indian ethnic wear from India to the USA, UK or Canada – delivery times, customs duties, sizing and returns.
body:
Ordering directly from India gets you authentic designs and better prices – but it helps to know how it works.

## Delivery times

Most made-to-order pieces take a few days to make, then 5–10 business days by express courier to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE or Australia. Always check the brand's timelines and order early for weddings and festivals.

## Customs and duties

Depending on your country, customs duties or import taxes can apply to parcels from India, and with many sellers the buyer pays them on delivery. At Bahe Kurtiz we ship duties-paid: import duties and taxes are included in our price, so there is nothing extra to pay when the parcel arrives.

## Sizing

Indian sizes often run smaller than Western sizes. Always check the brand's size chart in inches or centimetres – or choose made-to-measure so you don't need alterations.

## Returns

Custom-made outfits are usually final sale because they are stitched only for you. Check what happens if there is a defect or the fit is wrong due to the seller's error.

## Paying safely

Use secure payment methods like PayPal or a credit card, which offer buyer protection.

## Our checklist before you order

1. Check reviews from real customers.
2. Confirm delivery time and tracking.
3. Check the size chart or measurement guide.
4. Read the return policy.
5. Check whether duties and taxes are included (with us, they are).

## Made to measure, shipped worldwide

Every Bahe Kurtiz piece is made in our own Jaipur studio and can be stitched to your measurements at no extra cost. Pieces are made in 5–7 working days and shipped duties-paid by express courier with tracking, usually arriving in 5–10 business days in the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia.
